full_judgment: 4. The suit was followed by a prayer for temporary injunction under Order 39 of Rules 1 and 2 of the Code. In the prayer for temporary injunction it was averred among others that the land appertaining to R.S khatian no. 136 corresponding to S.A khatian no. 457 originally belonged to Motahar Ali Talukder and the said land was recorded correctly in his name both in R.S and S.A records of right. Motahar Ali Talukder while was in peaceful possession of the suit land orally gifted the land to his son Mojibur Rahman Talukder alias Nowab Mia, the predecessors of the plaintiffs. Mojibur Rahman Talukder died leaving the plaintiff nos. 1-11. The plaintiffs have been living at Barisal Sadar which is far away from the suit land. As such, they have been possessing the suit land through bargader. There is also a signboard in the suit land in the name and style of "Nowab Mia Vila". In the present survey the land is going to be recorded in the name of plaintiffs in D.P khatian no. 146.
